video_title: Chet Holmgren on a Strong Defensive Night | Postgame Media | October 22, 2026

quotes.speaker: Chet Holmgren
quotes.summary_phrase: Chet Holmgren on the team's aggressive defensive mindset
quotes.excerpt: I think we did a great job of being aggressive, not only guarding our yard, guarding the ball
quotes.quote: I think we did a great job of being aggressive, not only guarding our yard, guarding the ball, but also aggressive having each other's back. And when you're really aggressive on the ball, you're going to give up cracks and you're going to get beat at times, but that's okay when you know that somebody has your back on the backside and the rotations. I think we did a really good job of trusting each other to be there and then being there for each other.
quotes.social_post: Chet Holmgren on the Thunder defensive identity: When you are aggressive on the ball, you are going to give up cracks, but that is okay when you know that somebody has your back on the backside and the rotations.

structured.context: Chet Holmgren discusses the team's defensive performance and trust during a postgame media availability.

quotes.speaker: Chet Holmgren
quotes.summary_phrase: Chet Holmgren on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's selfless decision to sub out
quotes.excerpt: I told him he's a better man than me. I would have just been shooting some pull-up threes.
quotes.quote: I asked him, I said you want to shoot some threes right here? And he was like, no, and then he went up to Mark and subbed himself out. So I told him he's a better man than me. I would have just been shooting some pull-up threes. But I think it was a selfless moment and you know, he's a selfless guy. He's one of the hardest workers that I know and shows up out there and so does his leadership and he does that in a great way.
quotes.social_post: Chet Holmgren on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander subbing himself out late in the game: I asked him if he wanted to shoot some threes and he said no, then subbed himself out. He is a better man than me. I would have just been shooting pull-up threes.

structured.context: Chet Holmgren describes Shai Gilgeous-Alexander choosing to sub himself out of the game.

quotes.speaker: Chet Holmgren
quotes.summary_phrase: Chet Holmgren on the physical and mental endurance of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.excerpt: I don't think people understand how challenging it is. Not only to be talented enough to do it
quotes.quote: I don't think people understand how challenging it is. Not only to be talented enough to do it, but also he's never sprained an ankle and missed the rest of a game early on. He's never gotten ejected early on. Just the physical and mental endurance that it takes to do something like that is extremely impressive and it's not surprising. If anybody is able to do it, it's him.
quotes.social_post: Chet Holmgren on the physical and mental endurance of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: I do not think people understand how challenging it is. The physical and mental endurance that it takes to do something like that is extremely impressive.

structured.context: Chet Holmgren praises the physical and mental endurance of teammate Shai Gilgeous-Alexander.

quotes.speaker: Chet Holmgren
quotes.summary_phrase: Chet Holmgren on the Thunder's evolution and roster construction
quotes.excerpt: I think it's amazing how fluid basketball is and how open-minded and how much of a vision
quotes.quote: I think it's amazing how fluid basketball is and how open-minded and how much of a vision that I guess the Thunder organization has. In 2018, teams were putting nobody over 6-8 on the floor and then when I got here, the year I was hurt, we had no centers. Then it was kind of me and Jaylin Williams and now me and Jaylin Williams are power forwards and we got other centers out there. We've just gotten bigger over time and everything at the end of the day is about trade-offs and I think it's amazing having bigs that are more than good enough. There aren't a lot of negative trade-offs by having our size out there.
quotes.social_post: Chet Holmgren on the Thunder getting bigger: We have just gotten bigger over time and everything at the end of the day is about trade-offs. I think it is amazing having bigs that are more than good enough.

structured.context: Chet Holmgren reflects on the evolution of the Thunder roster and their increased size.

quotes.speaker: Chet Holmgren
quotes.summary_phrase: Chet Holmgren on the team's mindset despite being 2-0
quotes.excerpt: Me personally, I feel like so much area to improve, so much to clean up.
quotes.quote: We're 2-0, that's great. Me personally, I feel like so much area to improve, so much to clean up. I know we feel the same way as a team and that's the mindset we always try to have, whether we're 2-0, 0-2, one game in the season, 80 games in the season, we're looking at where we can be better and that's what we're going to do.
quotes.social_post: Chet Holmgren on the Thunder being 2-0: We are 2-0, that is great. Me personally, I feel like there is so much area to improve, so much to clean up. That is the mindset we always try to have.

structured.context: Chet Holmgren discusses the team's mindset after starting the season with a 2-0 record.

quotes.speaker: Chet Holmgren
quotes.summary_phrase: Chet Holmgren on the defensive impact of Isaiah Hartenstein
quotes.excerpt: People call me Go-Go Gadget, he's Go-Go Gadget. His arms are like forever.
quotes.quote: People call me Go-Go Gadget, he's Go-Go Gadget. His arms are like forever and he is, Mark said I was going to feel small next to him. I don't feel like he's that much taller than me, but he is, when you see him catch lobs and block shots, it's like he's not even off the ground and he's like above the square, which is physically impressive. But he's also got good timing, good instincts and then he's not afraid to go up there and try to get one and maybe not get it and get dunked on, you know, that's the life of a big and he understands that.
quotes.social_post: Chet Holmgren on Isaiah Hartenstein: His arms are like forever. When you see him catch lobs and block shots, it is like he is not even off the ground and he is above the square, which is physically impressive.

structured.context: Chet Holmgren comments on the defensive impact and physical attributes of teammate Isaiah Hartenstein.
